method.recruitment: Caller-relayed participant; one respondent, not a representative sample. Whether this person differs from P01/P02 was not controlled.
method.response_collection: Interactive ask questions with 分からない / 一部だけ分かった / 分かった / 画面を確認できない options plus free text; the eight neutral prompts are unchanged from participant-p01.json.
method.neutral_prompts: No correct answer or corrective guidance was supplied. Examiner setup: viewed candidate B before UX04; a separate unconfigured window before UX08.
setup_actions: UX01–UX03: fresh participant profile, fixture window, Artifact surface, no candidate viewed.
UX04: examiner viewed candidate B; the participant had already selected candidate A as the compare side in the dock.
UX05–UX07: participant operated freely; the participant maximized/ resized the window once, which is recorded but not interpreted.
UX08: the fixture window was closed and a separate window without fixture arguments was opened.
method.timing: The five-second condition was answered by the participant as 5秒以内 with a self-reported timer; no independent observer timer was attached, so it is participant-reported and not independently measured.
method.capture_scope: The UX01 start state and the UX08 disconnected state were captured as accessibility trees; intermediate action paths were not recorded, so no unspoken action is attributed.
method.response_detail: UX01, UX02, UX03, UX04, UX05, UX06, UX07 and UX08 were answered by selecting the comprehension option; UX08 also selected 両方とも分かった. No free-text elaboration was supplied, so no specific interpretation is quoted.

checks.setup: Viewed B with the local-selection caption visible in both the inspector and the Artifact surface; A held as the compare side.

checks.observation: The participant was on the Flow surface when the window was closed; the layered diagram with FLOW kind labels and the node/edge lists were on screen.

checks.prompt: 問題が起きています。何が起きていて、何ができると思いますか？必要なら画面を操作し、理解した内容を自由入力で教えてください。

comparison.not_controlled: Different sessions, one participant each, no representative sample and no controlled first-exposure condition; this is not a statistical comparison.
comparison.observation: The four items the Caller approved on 2026-10-31 (Flow diagram with lists, Compare next step and pair completion, Viewed versus Runtime-owned formal selection, intervention self-discovery) were all answered as understood.

boundaries.evidence_kind: Participant self-report; no free text was supplied for most items and the five-second claim is self-timed.
boundaries.owner_decisions: Product/UX acceptance, production promotion and any UX value change remain owner decisions; this record does not adopt a design value.
boundaries.media: No production media renderer, evidence-body acquisition or Runtime integration is supplied by UX1.
boundaries.processes: Both owned windows were closed through their semantic close control; each process exited 0.
